newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: PTT Serbia, Siemens sign 80 mln mark deal-Tanjug.
newsitem.headline: PTT Serbia, Siemens sign 80 mln mark deal-Tanjug.

text.p: Serbia's postal company PTT and Siemens of Germany signed on Tuesday an 80 million mark deal on production and delivery of advanced telecommunications equipment, Tanjug news agency said.
"Digital exchanges worth 73 million marks will provide 300,000 new telephone lines over next two years," PTT Serbia general manager Milorad Jaksic was quoted by Tanjug as saying.
Siemens will provide equipment worth 6.8 million marks and 150,000 new telephone lines through its Yugoslav joint venture VF-TEL in the course of this year, Tanjug said.
The Siemens-Europe telecommunications director Lotar Ploeve said the German concern was interested in long-term cooperation with PTT Serbia.
With this deal, Siemens equipment will account for 25 percent of all new equipment purchased and installed by the Serbian PTT, Ploeve was quoted as saying.

PTT Serbia has strengthened its drive to catch up with international telecom network, but still needs to upgrade its internal system which deteriorated during the 3-1/2 years of sanctions and neglect.

In a bid to upgrade its ailing phone system, Serbia plans to install three million new lines by 2005 and double the number of lines to 40 per 100 inhabitants. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom 381 11 222 42 75
